About this item

  • 【Effortless Cutting & Artistic Beauty】Ultra-sharp blades hand-sharpened to a precise 15° angle per side, balancing lasting sharpness and everyday durability. Whether slicing vegetables or carving meat, each cut requires minimal effort. Beyond performance, every blade features a mirror-polished finish that reflects light like an art piece, transforming cooking into pure pleasure while elevating your kitchen aesthetics
  • 【Superior Durability Through Advanced Craftsmanship】Built to last, each knife undergoes repeated forging and low-temperature quenching, achieving a Rockwell hardness of 56 ± 2 HRC. This process ensures exceptional strength and edge retention for years of daily use. The full-tang construction provides perfect balance and uncompromising durability, giving you confidence with every chop and slice
  • 【Effortless Maintenance with Built-In Sharpener】Keeping knives razor-sharp has never been easier. The wooden block features a built-in sharpener perfect for beginners—simply draw the blade through the slot a few times to restore its factory-sharp edge. No special skills required. This easy-to-use tool ensures your knives consistently perform at their best, so you're always ready to cook without the frustration of dull blades
  • 【Complete 14-Piece Knife Set with Thoughtful Storage】Includes: 8" chef knife, 7" Santoku, 8" bread knife, 8" slicing knife, 3.5" paring knife, 5" utility knife, 6*4.5" serrated steak knives, kitchen shears, and solid wood block. The block features a ventilation slot at the bottom for optimal airflow, keeping knives dry. Everything stays neatly organized, freeing up drawer space and keeping your countertop tidy
  • 【The Perfect Gift with Peace of Mind】Ideal for housewarming, birthday, wedding, or treating yourself—this set makes a thoughtful gift for women who love cooking. Backed by a 1-year warranty and hassle-free returns or exchanges
  • A NOTE ON OUR BRAND LOGO: You may receive a set featuring our classic or updated logo on the blade and block, as we are in a period of brand enhancement. This visual update does not affect the exceptional quality, sharpness, or ergonomic design you expect. All materials and construction are identical. We appreciate your understanding as our imagery updates to reflect the new design

From the brand

  2. About imarku

    Founded in 1949 by a Japanese family of bladesmiths, each knife is crafted through 108 traditional forging steps. Hand-folded steel forms 32,768 layers for balanced strength and durability. A clay-tempered edge, finished at 15° and hand-polished with 3000-grit stones, delivers precise, dependable performance. Trusted by professional kitchens since entering the U.S. in 2016.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Meet cleavers are not just for cutting meat. I have had this knif for around a year. This is the best knife I have ever used for cutting ALL my food, not just meat. All the reviews that wrote that they can't get a sharp edge on it, don't know how to sharpen a knife! This is one of the easiest knives I've ever sharpened. I use a chefs rod sharpener and it come out very sharp EVERY time. If you don't know how to sharpen a knife, that is one thing. But don't write that it is a cheap knife that won't get a sharp edge just because you don't know how to sharpen a high quility carbon steel cleaver. And the review that said that it is to heavy, that he will be using it instead to chop wood, doesn't realize that all good quality cleavers are heavy like this. News flash. This is a meat cleaver. If you want a ax, go buy an ax. I have used it at least sixty times to cut food for dinner. This knife is made of fantastic high carbon stainless steel. It should be at least three times the price. That's how good this knife is. It also comes with a thick, good quality leather sheath. It is relitvly easy to sharpen. It really holds an edge incredably, once sharpened. The steel is not to hard where it becomes brittle. It's also not to soft where it won't hold an edge. The hardness is just the correct balance. It holds an edge better than my $150 great brand camping knife. Once the food is cut on my chopping block, I can easily scrap up the food onto the side of the knife, having the blade go under the side of my hand and pushing it onto the knife then picking up the food and putting it into a bowl, frying pan ect., just the way the chefs do in Chinese restaurants. It is much more efficient that way. That is what makes this a much better option for cutting ALL my food, rather than using a regular chefs knife. I know. I used to be a chef in a five star restaurant in CT. This knife is just as good as the expensive $140 knives that were bought from a restayrant supply company for the restaurant I worked at . So, buy it. You won't be disappointed with it!!!

About this Item

  • 【Effortless Cutting & Artistic Beauty】Ultra-sharp blades hand-sharpened to a precise 15° angle per side, balancing lasting sharpness and everyday durability. Whether slicing vegetables or carving meat, each cut requires minimal effort.   • 【Superior Durability Through Advanced Craftsmanship】Built to last, each knife undergoes repeated forging and low-temperature quenching, achieving a Rockwell hardness of 56 ± 2 HRC. This process ensures exceptional strength and edge retention for years of daily use. The full-tang construction provides perfect balance and uncompromising durability, giving you confidence with every chop and slice
  • 【Effortless Maintenance with Built-In Sharpener】Keeping knives razor-sharp has never been easier. The wooden block features a built-in sharpener perfect for beginners—simply draw the blade through the slot a few times to restore its factory-sharp edge. No special skills required. This easy-to-use tool ensures your knives consistently perform at their best, so you're always ready to cook without the frustration of dull blades
  • 【Complete 14-Piece Knife Set with Thoughtful Storage】Includes: 8" chef knife, 7" Santoku, 8" bread knife, 8" slicing knife, 3.5" paring knife, 5" utility knife, 6*4.5" serrated steak knives, kitchen shears, and solid wood block.   • 【The Perfect Gift with Peace of Mind】Ideal for housewarming, birthday, wedding, or treating yourself—this set makes a thoughtful gift for women who love cooking. Backed by a 1-year warranty and hassle-free returns or exchanges

Product Description

Who is this knife set designed for? This 14-piece knife set is thoughtfully designed for home cooks who take joy in preparing meals for their families—whether you're a busy mom chopping veggies for weeknight stir-fries, a newlywed building your first kitchen, or someone who loves hosting dinner parties. The ergonomic handles fit comfortably in smaller hands, while the balanced weight reduces wrist strain during extended food prep . It's the kitchen companion that grows with you, from your first homemade soup to your signature holiday roast. What makes these knives so sharp and easy to use? Each blade is hand-sharpened to a precise 15° angle per side—the sweet spot where razor-sharpness meets everyday durability . Whether you're slicing through ripe tomatoes without crushing them, carving Sunday roasts, or dicing onions for family dinners, every cut requires minimal effort. Beyond performance, the mirror-polished finish catches the light like fine jewelry, transforming ordinary meal prep into a moment of everyday elegance that brightens your time in the kitchen. How durable are these knives? Will they last through years of daily use? Absolutely. Each knife is crafted through repeated forging and low-temperature quenching—a meticulous heat treatment process that achieves a Rockwell hardness of 56 ± 2 HRC . This ensures exceptional edge retention and strength through thousands of meals. The full-tang construction means the blade extends through the entire handle, providing perfect balance and uncompromising durability. You'll feel the confidence with every chop, slice, and dice, knowing these knives are built for generations of family cooking. I'm a beginner—how do I keep the knives sharp? That's the beauty of this set—maintenance couldn't be simpler. The solid wood block features a built-in sharpener designed specifically for beginners . Just draw the blade through the slot a few times, and it restores that factory-sharp edge. No special skills or expensive tools needed. This means your knives stay in peak condition year after year, so you're always ready to cook without the frustration of dull blades. It's like having a professional sharpener built right into your countertop. What's included in this set? Will it cover all my kitchen needs? This all-in-one 14-piece collection includes everything you'll ever need : 8" chef knife (your go-to for most tasks), 7" Santoku (perfect for precise slicing), 8" bread knife (glides through crusty loaves), 8" slicing knife (ideal for roasts and meats), 3.5" paring knife (for fruits and small tasks), 5" utility knife (versatile everyday use), six 4.5" serrated steak knives (for dinner parties), and kitchen shears. The FSC-certified solid wood block keeps everything neatly organized, with a ventilation slot at the bottom for airflow—keeping your knives dry, hygienic, and always within reach. Is this set a good gift for someone special? Yes—it's the gift that says "I believe in your dreams" to a friend starting their first home, "thank you for every meal" to your mom, or "you deserve this" to yourself . Beautifully packaged and backed by a 1-year hassle-free warranty, it's a present that combines everyday utility with lasting beauty. Whether for housewarmings, weddings, birthdays, or holiday celebrations, it's a thoughtful choice for any woman who finds joy in cooking for the ones she loves. Can these knives handle different types of food prep? From juicy meats and crusty breads to delicate herbs and firm vegetables—these knives handle them all with ease. The high-carbon stainless steel resists rust and staining, even with acidic ingredients like tomatoes and citrus . The serrated steak knives glide through perfectly cooked steaks at dinner parties, while the chef's knife makes quick work of weekly meal prep. Whatever you're making—from Tuesday night pasta to Sunday roasts—the right knife is ready and waiting. How should I care for these knives? While the blades are dishwasher-safe, we recommend hand washing with mild soap and immediate drying to preserve the mirror-polished finish and razor edge for years to come . Store them in the included wood block—never loose in drawers where blades can dull. And remember, that built-in sharpener is your best friend for quick touch-ups. With minimal care, these knives will remain your trusted kitchen companions through countless family meals and celebrations.
